evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Because PHP wrappers are case-insensitive and the patch only checks the presence of the phar:// string, it can be bypassed to achieve remote code execution again using a different case.

audit.evidence: Real composer knplabs/knp-snappy bytes per version (1.4.1/1.4.2/1.4.3) on PHP 7.4-cli. Tiny HTTP service passes user-supplied filename to real Knp\Snappy\Pdf::generateFromHtml(); prepareOutput calls file_exists on the phar:// path triggering PHAR metadata deserialization of a benign BenignMarker gadget. Lowercase phar:// reaches flag on V0, blocked by strpos on V1; uppercase PHAR:// bypasses strpos on V1, blocked by allowlist+mb_strtolower on V2. Gate passed.

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification with composer knplabs/knp-snappy 1.4.1/1.4.2/1.4.3 on php:7.4-cli. Recipe-based: images built at compose time, PHAR built at image build, canary planted in environment via compose entrypoint. Gate run 2026-07-17. Lowercase phar:///app/evil.phar/x triggers deser on V0 (flag returned), blocked on V1 (strpos rejects phar://). Uppercase PHAR:///app/evil.phar/x triggers deser on V1 (strpos misses PHAR://), blocked on V2 (allowlist+mb_strtolower). All 4 checks correct.
